name: designbridge
description: Use locally captured Lanhu designs in Codex to inspect UI layers, styles, slices, and comments while implementing interfaces.

interface.shortDescription: Implement UI from captured Lanhu designs
interface.longDescription: DesignBridge connects Codex to locally captured Lanhu designs. Use a designbridge:// link to inspect a whole design or a selected module, read nested layers and styles, retrieve linked slices, and apply nearby Lanhu comments as implementation constraints in the current business project.
defaultPrompt: Implement this UI module from a DesignBridge link
Inspect the selected Lanhu layer and its child layers
Find the slices and comments needed for this design
